seguridad.denunciarCuerpo: Choose what you want to report. The team will review the profile and may remove content or suspend their social access.
seguridad.denunciaRegistrada: Report submitted for review. You can also block this person.
seguridad.bloquearMensaje: You'll stop seeing each other in requests and rankings, including the ludus. The friendship will be removed.
seguridad.desbloquearMensaje: They'll be able to send you a friend request again. The old friendship isn't restored. If you share a ludus, they'll show up again.

duelo.a11yOcultoMia: Duel with {{nombre}}, {{quedan}}. Your discipline {{mia}}. No rival data.

lista.a11yQuitar: {{puesto}}. {{nombre}}, level {{nivel}}, {{valor}}. Tap for more options. Long-press to remove.

codigo.yaSoisRivales: {{nombre}} had already looked you up. You're rivals now.
codigo.solicitudEnviada: Request sent to {{nombre}}. Waiting for their answer.
codigo.tuCodigoCuerpo: Anyone with it can send you a friend request. They'll see your level, your streak and your completion; never your health, your money or your journal.

solicitudes.quitarMensaje: {{nombre}} will leave your ranking and you'll leave theirs. Getting back will take a new request.
solicitudes.entrante: Level {{nivel}} · wants to take you on

ludus.formandose: Your ludus is still forming. The system is adding gladiators with your same goal.
ludus.ayuda: The same numbers as the friends ranking: penalties don't count and nobody buys a place. No chat: in the ludus you compete with actions.
ludus.peticionCuerpo: Goal: {{objetivo}}. Each ludus is formed by hand, with {{min}} to {{max}} Élite gladiators with the same goal. It will show up here.
ludus.presentacion: A ludus is your gladiator school: {{min}} to {{max}} Élite members with the same goal, measured every week. No chat, no noise, just the scoreboard. Choose yours and the system assigns you a place.

subtitulo.vacio: Nobody improves the same way when someone's watching the scoreboard.
subtitulo.rivalesResponder_one: {{count}} rival in your arena · {{porResponder}} to answer.
subtitulo.rivalesResponder_other: {{count}} rivals in your arena · {{porResponder}} to answer.

vista.preparandoSemana: Getting your week ready to share

ocultos.detalle: They've hidden their scoreboard. Still your friend.
ocultos.a11y: {{nombre}}, out of the ranking. Tap to report or block. Long-press to remove.

ranking.vacioCuerpo: Alone, you ease off. With a rival watching, the day you were going to skip gets done. Give your code to someone who really pushes you: one is enough.

ayuda.xp: XP earned from missions in the period. Penalty missions don't count: catching up isn't getting ahead. Long-press someone to remove them.
ayuda.cumplimiento: Missions completed out of scheduled. Today only counts once you complete it. Long-press someone to remove them.
ayuda.racha: Consecutive closed days. It's the only number that doesn't depend on the period. Long-press someone to remove them.

invitados.ayuda: Counts anyone who joins with your code and is active 3 days in their first two weeks. It's a badge: it gives no XP or Pro days.

convivencia.cuerpo: No harassment, threats, impersonation or offensive content. Names, titles and photos are reviewed before others see them: until then they'll see a neutral alias and image. Your profile keeps your details.

privacidad.visible: Your friends see your level, your streak, your XP for the period and your completion. Nothing else.
privacidad.oculto: You're out: your friends don't see your numbers or your portrait. You still see theirs.

competicion.regla: Discipline is what's measured: how much of your own plan you complete, weighted by difficulty. Piling on missions doesn't win. On a tie, more active days.
competicion.retoEnviado: Challenge sent · waiting for their answer
competicion.vacio: Nobody's measuring you this week. Challenge a friend.
competicion.vacioAyuda: A duel lasts one week, Monday to Sunday. {{regla}}
competicion.vacioAyudaLigas: A duel lasts one week, Monday to Sunday. A league brings together up to {{max}} friends. {{regla}}
competicion.sinAmigos: To challenge someone, they have to be your friend first.
competicion.masOpciones: More options for the duel with {{nombre}}
competicion.masOpcionesPista: Send a report or block user
competicion.sinDatosRival: No rival data · discipline this week

retar.enviado: Challenge sent to {{nombre}}. It starts when they accept.
retar.ayuda: {{regla}} It's the only metric and the only duration for a duel: that way nobody picks the one that suits them.

liga.miembrosSinDatos_one: {{count}} member · no data yet this week
liga.miembrosSinDatos_other: {{count}} members · no data yet this week
liga.nombreCorto: Give it a name of at least 2 letters.
liga.crearAyuda: Only friends you invite can join, and each one decides whether to accept. Up to {{max}} members. The table resets every Monday. {{regla}}
liga.invitacionEnviada: Invite sent to {{nombre}}. They join when they accept.
liga.soloCreador: Only the league's creator can invite.
liga.salirMensaje: You'll stop seeing their table and they'll stop seeing yours. If you created it, the league is disbanded for everyone.
liga.tableroAyuda: The number is this week's discipline, from 0 to 100. Ties are broken by pace against your previous four weeks.
liga.invitarAyuda: Only the league's creator can invite. If you didn't create it, ask them to invite whoever you want to add.
